response.text: {"verdict": "not_covered", "clause_ids": ["A7.5"], "rationale": "The mobile phone is considered a valuable item and electronic equipment. According to clause A7.5, the insurer does not cover theft of valuable items and electronics left unattended in a vehicle or in a publicly accessible area. The evidence indicates the bag was lost at the airport, and the mobile phone was among the items declared, suggesting it may have been left unattended."}
